title: Delete a message
summary: Delete a message for everyone in the chat (Matrix redaction). A confirm comes first. The message then shows as a deleted line.

confirming.description: The item id waiting for the confirm.

isOwn.description: The message is the person's own.

confirm.effect: Timeline.redactEvent with the item id and no reason. A message that is still sending is cancelled with Timeline.abortSend instead.

notes: A redacted message (MsgLikeKind Redacted) shows bipe_app_deleted_own or bipe_app_deleted_other in place of the body, with no actions and no reactions.
There is no delete for me only. Clearing a whole chat is the chat list's Apagar conversa (parity dm-delete).
The other person's app may have shown a notification already; the confirm body says the message goes away for everyone in the chat, nothing more.
